newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-INJURED PEREC PULLS OUT OF WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-INJURED PEREC PULLS OUT OF WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: France's double Olympic champion Marie-Jose Perec pulled out of the semifinals of the world women's 200 metres on Thursday after pulling a leg muscle while warming up for the race.
The Olympic 200 and 400 metres champion, who originally did not want to compete here because of her disappointing form this season, hurt a thigh muscle and left the warm-up area in tears.
